subject: Your invite link is live, plus a cleaner Today screen
message:
Hey {name},

Thank you for being part of Mileset this early. Your support is what keeps this going, and big things are coming soon.

Three updates from this week:

Your invite link: open More, then Your invite link. Send it to a training partner and see how many people joined through you.

Watch connected? No more morning survey. Today shows your readiness, sleep, HRV and resting heart rate straight from your watch.

A cleaner Today screen: your workout sits at the top, and your race countdown shows days to go and how far through your plan you are.

As a founding member, Mileset is free for you for life. If a friend runs, lifts or races, send them your link before the Founding 100 spots run out.

We're on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/hybrdrunning/ for training tips and updates.

Got an idea or something you'd change? Just reply. I read every one.

Matthew
Mileset
